Diagnostic CFD only: no reliable steady convergence; no design ranking. Actual meshes and solver outputs are saved. The source is assumed, not measured. Failed ideal-gas runs and early loose-tolerance samples are excluded from design recommendations.

Values average an assumed 50 × 50 mm region at 200 mm from the core exit. The shield also has a separate 232 mm sample to preserve 200 mm clear distance from its mouth. These are not comfort predictions.

CFD maps

Model used: Low-Mach Boussinesq buoyancy, constant density in continuity, approximate total-temperature transport, k–epsilon RANS and first-order upwind convection. First-order numerical mixing and the finite domain require sensitivity checks. No human body, skin heat transfer, moisture or internal vortex is simulated. No validated winning geometry is claimed.
